UPSC Engineering Services Mains Admit Card 2026 - Complete Details

UPSC Engineering Services Mains Admit Card 2026. Candidates can now download their admit card / hall ticket from the official website before the exam date. Check important dates, application fee, eligibility criteria and official links below.

  • UPSC Engineering Services Examination Online Form : UPSC Engineering Services Final Result With Marks

Application Fee

How to Download Admit Card

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the admit card / hall ticket link.
  3. Enter your registration number / roll number and date of birth / password.
  4. Click on submit to view your admit card.
  5. Download and take a printout. Carry it to the exam center along with a photo ID.
